description: Monero Village focuses on financial privacy, decentralized systems, cryptocurrency cryptography, and censorship resistance. Talks cover cross-chain atomic swaps, off-grid mesh networks, electronic badge hacking, and blockchain economics.

talks.title: Open Office Q&A
talks.teaser: Dr. Sarang of the Monero Research Lab answers community questions about Monero cryptography, research, and privacy.

talks.title: Decentralization in a Centralized World
talks.teaser: Explores the importance of preserving decentralization and financial privacy within an increasingly centralized digital world.

talks.title: Monero Trivia
talks.teaser: Interactive Monero community trivia contest covering privacy technology, cryptocurrency history, and meme culture.

talks.title: Badge Clinic
talks.teaser: Walks through the assembly, troubleshooting, and programming of the DEF CON Safe Mode Monero electronic badge.

talks.title: Meme Competition
talks.teaser: Community meme competition showcasing creative and satirical artwork celebrating cryptocurrency and digital privacy.

talks.title: Bitcoin Monero Atomic Swaps
talks.teaser: Explains the cryptographic protocol and implementation details behind trustless cross-chain Bitcoin-Monero atomic swaps.

talks.title: You're Not the Money Printer: Coinbase Outputs
talks.teaser: Analyzes Monero coinbase transaction outputs, mining reward distributions, and their implications for on-chain privacy.

talks.title: Zcoin Competition
talks.teaser: Overview and results of the Zcoin privacy challenge and cross-community privacy technology competition.

talks.title: Welcome Talk
talks.teaser: Welcomes attendees to DEF CON Safe Mode Monero Village and outlines the village schedule, talks, and workshops.

talks.title: Monero Wallet Basics
talks.teaser: Guides beginners through setting up, securing, and backing up Monero wallets for private, anonymous transactions.

talks.title: Locha Mesh: Monero Off the Grid
talks.teaser: Presents Locha Mesh, an open-source decentralized radio mesh networking device for transmitting Monero transactions offline.

talks.title: Badge Clinic 2
talks.teaser: Continues hands-on debugging, firmware flashing, and hardware troubleshooting for the Monero electronic badge.

talks.title: Closing Talk
talks.teaser: Concludes DEF CON Safe Mode Monero Village with a recap of events, contests, and future community initiatives.

talks.title: Transaction Capacity and Fees
talks.teaser: Examines Monero's dynamic block size algorithm, transaction scaling capacity, and long-term fee economics.
